tickets.summary: PSV-3420’s illegible certification tag limits identification, not demonstrated relief capability: certification is in date and the valve appears sound; actual relief failure would remove compressor-discharge overpressure protection.
tickets.recommended_action: Have integrity engineering match valve identity to the March 2025 certificate, replace the corroded tag and verify legible, correct certification details; retain the two-year pop-test cycle.

likelihood_of_failure.rationale: The assessed function is compressor-discharge overpressure relief. The corroded certification label does not demonstrate valve deterioration. In-date recertification, satisfactory reported behaviour and sound observed physical condition support little indication of near-term function loss.

impact_of_failure.rationale: Hypothetical loss of compressor-discharge overpressure relief would remove a nonredundant safety protection layer, creating credible major-accident exposure. This supports a severe consequence band, not an extreme scenario unsupported by the supplied details. Label replacement cost does not determine impact.
